title: Audit
description: Audit trail of SysInfo over 30 days: number of calls from the window and from AI agents (MCP), actions run, previews, declined, blocked and failed actions; the latest actions with origin (window or MCP client), tool, level, confirmation, result, parameters, changes (before / after) and whether they can be undone; the most called tools and the latest errors. Findings flag actions run by an AI agent in the last 24 hours and repeated declined requests. The log is the one of the account running SysInfo.

functions.name: get_log
functions.title: Journal
functions.help: Relit le journal de tout ce que SysInfo a fait : outils lancés depuis cette fenêtre ou par un agent IA, aperçus, actions confirmées ou refusées, erreurs. « Depuis » limite la période ; Origine, Type, Outil et Résultat filtrent les lignes. L'Id d'une ligne sert à annuler une action.
functions.description: Entries of the SysInfo audit log, newest first, filtered: id, time, origin (window or MCP client), account, tool, level, preview or not, confirmation, result, duration, parameters, finding codes, changes, restore point and error. Use the id with audit_undo.

parameters.name: sinceHours
parameters.label: Depuis (heures)
parameters.description: Time window, in hours before now.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.label: Origine
parameters.description: all, ui (SysInfo window) or mcp (AI agents).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.label: Type
parameters.description: all, actions (levels A and C) or reads.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.label: Outil
parameters.description: Keep only tools whose name contains this text.

functions.name: undo
functions.title: Annuler une action
functions.help: Annule une action passée en rejouant son action inverse (ex. réactiver un programme au démarrage que l'on avait désactivé). Copier l'Id depuis le Journal. « Simuler » montre ce qui serait rétabli. Seules les actions qui ont une annulation enregistrée peuvent être annulées.
functions.description: Undoes an action of the audit log (last 90 days) by running its recorded undo, a reverse action of the same module: start a stopped service, re-enable a startup item, restore a process priority… The preview is the reverse action's preview. Blocked when the entry changed nothing, has no undo, was already undone, or when the undo is itself a critical action (then call that tool directly).

parameters.name: id
parameters.label: Id de l'entrée
parameters.description: Id of the audit entry (from audit_get_log or the Actions card).

functions.name: export_log
functions.title: Exporter le journal
functions.help: Enregistre le journal d'audit de la période choisie dans Documents/SysInfo/Exports, par exemple pour le joindre à un ticket. Le fichier contient les noms des outils et leurs paramètres : à relire avant de le partager.
functions.description: Writes the audit log of a period to a new JSON file in Documents/SysInfo/Exports (never overwriting). Returns the file path, not its content.

parameters.name: sinceHours
parameters.label: Depuis (heures)
parameters.description: Time window, in hours before now.
